credit: NASA's Scientific Visualization Studio; LRO/LROC/LOLA; visualization by Ernie Wright
color_version: NASA December 2025 color map, sRGB encoded 16-bit RGB TIFF
color_conversion: Pillow decodes source 16-bit sRGB to 8-bit RGB; no new gamma transform, tone adjustment, or generated detail. Original embedded sRGB IEC61966-2.1 ICC profile retained. 4k JPEG quality 95, 4:4:4, progressive, optimized. 2k version resampled in linear light with Lanczos, re-encoded to sRGB; JPEG quality 94, 4:4:4, progressive, optimized.
height_conversion: Source unsigned 16-bit LOLA elevation read without truncating precision; float32 Lanczos downsample to 2048x1024, normalized against original full source min/max, rounded to 8-bit grayscale lossless PNG. No sharpening or artificial terrain.

usage.flipY: Keep TextureLoader default flipY=true for standard SphereGeometry; same flipY on all maps. North is image top. No horizontal flip or channel inversion needed.
usage.bumpScale: Positive. Begin around 0.01 for radius-1 geometry, tune aesthetically; 0.025 is exaggerated. Bump changes shading only, not silhouette.
usage.map_projection: 2:1 equirectangular, longitude 0 degrees at horizontal center, north at top. Standard unrotated Three.js SphereGeometry places this central meridian toward +X; rotate the sphere if camera is on +Z.
usage.science_note: NASA labels color textures as optimized for aesthetics rather than scientific measurement; original TIFF sources preserved separately.
